explanation: The One who has vast mercy for all of creation in this world, and especially for the believers in the Hereafter.
The One whose mercy is focused especially upon the believers. A mercy that is specific and earned.
The One who owns the dominion of the whole universe with no partner.
The One who is pure from any imperfection and clear of any partner or likeness.
The One who is free from every imperfection. He is the giver of peace and security to His servants.
The One who witnessed for Himself that no one is God but Him. He gives security to His servants.
The One who witnesses the saying and deeds of His creatures. He is the protector and overseer.
The One who no one can overcome or resist. The All-Powerful, Mighty.
The One that nothing happens in His dominion except what He wills. He compels all things.
The One who is clear from the attributes of creation and is characterized by greatness.
The One who brings everything from non-existence to existence according to His knowledge and will.
The One who created all beings from nothing, differentiated from one another by His will.
The One who forms His creatures in whatever image He wills. He gives each thing its unique form.
The One who forgives the sins of His servants time and time again.
The One who has the perfect Power and is not powerless over anything. He subdues everything.
The One who is generous in giving without any compensation. He gives endlessly from His bounty.
The One who creates sustenance for all creatures and provides it for them in all circumstances.

meaning: The Opener, The Granter of Success
explanation: The One who opens for His servants the closed worldly and religious matters. He decides all things.
The One nothing is absent from His knowledge. He knows the seen and unseen, past, present, and future.
The One who constricts the sustenance by His wisdom and expands and widens it with His generosity.
The One who extends the sustenance to whomever He wills. He is generous and open-handed.
The One who lowers whoever He willed. He humbles the arrogant and the tyrant.
The One who raises whoever He willed by His Endowment. He honors the believers and raises them.
The One who gives esteem to whoever He willed. He gives honor and dignity to His chosen servants.
The One who humiliates whoever He willed. He debases the arrogant enemies of truth.
The One who hears all things that are heard by His Eternal Hearing without an ear, instrument or organ.
The One who sees all things that are seen by His Eternal Seeing without a pupil or any other instrument.
The One who judges between His creatures with His justice. He is the arbiter between them.
The One who is entitled to do what He does. He does not wrong anyone in the slightest.
The One who is kind to His servants. He knows the subtle secrets and inner realities of all things.
The One who knows the truth of things. He is aware of all inner realities and hidden matters.
The One who delays the punishment for those who deserve it and then forgives them.
The One deserving the attributes of Exaltation, Glory, Extolement, and Purity from all imperfection.
The One who forgives a lot. His forgiveness encompasses all sins for those who seek it.
The One who gives a lot of reward for a little obedience. He multiplies rewards for good deeds.
The One who is clear from the attributes of the creatures. He is above all things in His essence.
The One who is greater than everything in status. His greatness is incomparable.
The One who protects whatever and whoever He willed to protect. He preserves His creation.
The One who has the Power. He maintains and nourishes all that exists.
The One who gives the satisfaction. He suffices His servants and takes account of all things.
The One who is attributed with greatness of Power and Glory of status. He possesses absolute majesty.
The One who is clear from abjectness. He is generous, giving abundantly to all.
The One that nothing is absent from Him. He watches over and observes all things constantly.
The One who answers the one in need if he asks Him and rescues the yearner if he calls upon Him.
The One who is Ample giving. He encompasses all things by His power, knowledge, and mercy.
The One who acts with wisdom in everything He does and decrees. His wisdom is absolute.
The One who loves His believing servants and His believing servants love Him. He shows deep affection.
The One who is with perfect Power, High Status, Compassion, Generosity and Kindness.
The One who sends the Messengers to guide the servants. He raises the dead for the Day of Judgment.
The One who nothing is absent from Him. He witnesses all things in all times and places.
The One who truly exists. He is the Truth, and everything other than Him is contingent.

meaning: The Trustee, The Disposer of Affairs
explanation: The One who gives the satisfaction and is relied upon. He manages all the affairs of His creation.
The One with the complete Power. His strength is unlimited and incomparable.
The One with extreme Power which is un-interrupted and He does not get tired.
The One who supports His believing servants. He is the ally and helper of the righteous.
The praised One who deserves to be praised. All praise belongs to Him in all circumstances.
The One who the count of things are known to him. He keeps count of all things without omission.
The One who started the human being. He is the first cause of all creation.
The One who brings back the creatures after death. He will recreate all things on the Day of Resurrection.
The One who took out a living human from semen that does not have a soul. He gives life to the dead.
The One who renders the living dead. He decrees death and causes it by His power.
The One attributed with a life that is unlike our life and is not that of a combination of soul, flesh or blood.
The One who remains and does not end. He is self-sufficient and everything else depends on Him.
The One who is Needless. He finds what He wills when He wills. Nothing escapes Him.
The One who is Most Glorious. He is generous and noble in His essence and attributes.
The One without a partner. He is unique in His essence, attributes, and actions.
The One who has no partners in His Lordship. He is absolutely One without any division.
The Master who is relied upon in matters and the One to whom recourse is had in one's needs.
The One attributed with Power. He is able to do whatever He wills.
The One with the perfect Power that nothing is withheld from Him. He has full control over all things.
The One who puts things in their right places. He brings forward whomever He wills.
The One who puts things in their right places. He delays what He wills to delay.
The One whose Existence is without a beginning. He existed before all creation.
The One whose Existence is without an end. He will remain after all creation ceases.
The One who is clear from all things. He is apparent through His signs and creation.
The One whose true nature is hidden from human perception. He is close yet beyond comprehension.
The One who owns things and manages them. He governs over all creation with wisdom.

meaning: The Most Exalted, The High Exalted
explanation: The One who is clear from the attributes of the creation. He is exalted above everything.
The One who is kind to His creatures. He is the origin of all goodness and righteousness.
The One who grants repentance to whoever He willed among His creatures and accepts their repentance.
The One who victoriously prevails over His enemies and punishes them for their sins.
The One who pardons all who sincerely seek forgiveness. He effaces sins completely.
The One with extreme Mercy. He shows compassion beyond measure to His creation.
The One who controls the dominion and gives dominion to whoever He willed. All sovereignty is His.
The One who deserves to be Exalted and not denied. He possesses both absolute majesty and generosity.
The One who is Just in His judgment. He deals with all in absolute fairness and impartiality.
The One who gathers the creatures on a day that there is no doubt about, that is the Day of Judgment.
The One who does not need the creation. He is absolutely free of any need.
The One who satisfies the necessities of the creatures. He enriches whomever He wills.
The Supporter who protects and gives victory to His righteous servants. He withholds when wise.
The One who makes harm reach to whoever He willed and in whatever way He willed.
The One who gives benefits to whoever He willed. All benefit comes only from Him.
The One who guided His servants to His Light. He is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
The One whom with His Guidance His believers were guided, and with His Guidance the living things have been guided.
The One who created the creation and formed it without any preceding example. He is unprecedented.
The One that the state of non-existence is impossible for Him. He endures forever.

meaning: The Heir, The Inheritor of All
explanation: The One whose Existence remains. He is the ultimate inheritor of all things after all creation ceases.

meaning: The Guide to the Right Path
explanation: The One who guides. He leads His servants to the straight path through wisdom and revelation.
The One who does not quickly punish the sinners. He is patient and gives respite to repent.
